main_text.p: qui parentibus vim vel atrocem iniuriam inferunt: qua-les sunt parricidae, parentum percussores, parentibus ma-ledicentes, parentibus rebellantes: item de poenis illo-rum, qui in magistratum, & ecclesiae ministros sunt iniu-rii. Exod. 21. v. 11. 15. 17. c. 22. v. 28. Deut. 17. v. 12. c. 21, v. 18.5 6.27.v.16.[?] Pertinet quoque huc lex regia Deut. 17.
main_text.head: Ad sextum praeceptum.
main_text.p: 1. Leges de homicidio voluntario & involuntario. Exod. 21. v. 12.13.18.20. 21.Levit. 24. v. 17. 18. Num. 35. v.16. Deut. 27. v. 24. c. 19. v. 4.10
2. Leges de mutilationibus & percussionibus. Exod.21. vers. 22. 26. quò pertinet lex talionis.
3. Lex de reperto occisi cadauere. Deut. 21. v. 1.
4. Lex de bove cornupetâ laedente hominem. Exod.21. v.28.32.15
5. Lex de numero plagarum alicui infligendarum. Deut.25.v.2.
6. Lex de non lædendis peregrinis. Exod.22.v.21.c.23. v.9. Leuit.19.v.33.
7. Lex de servo profugo ob sævitiam heri. Deut.23.v.15. vers.15.
8. Lex de nido avium[?] reperto. Deut.22.v.6.
9. Lex de non comedendo sanguine bestiæ. Leuit.7. v.26.c.17.v.10.c.19.v.26. Deut.12.v.15.20.

10. Leges polemicæ, sive bellicæ: cuiusmodi sunt, de 25 concione sacerdotis antequam prælium ineatur Deut.20. vers.1. de personis, à bello immunibus, quæ non debent proficisci in militiam. Deut.20.v.5.7.8. de ætate in militiam adscribendorum Num.1. vers.3.c.26.v.2. de transitu militum per terras fratrum. Num.20.v.17. Deut.2. vers.4. 30 de exploratoribus, eorumque missione. Num.13.v.3.19. Deut.1.ver.22. de munditiæ castrorum. Deut.23.v.9.12. de ducibus in primâ acie constituendis. Deut.20.v.9. de arboribus frugiferis non excindendis. Deut.20.v.19. de pace offerendâ, vel non offerendâ. Deut.20.v.10. de prædâ 35 ritè distribuendâ. Num.31.v.26.

page.notes: The reading "6.27.v.16." at the start of the line after "c.21, v.18." is uncertain; the first character may be a c. The word "Levit." was printed with "Leuit." and is given in modern spelling by the u/v rule. Notes 5, 10 and 15 are printed numbers in the right margin. Line numbers 25, 30 and 35 stand beside the column and are given in the text at their lines. "avium" in item 8 is doubtful: the word is blurred. "munditiæ" is read from a blurred word. The top of the page is cut off, so the first line is a fragment of an earlier item.
